name: Laser beam
summary: Glowing straight laser that fires between two points with a white core and impact sparks; for shots and zaps.

params.name: s
params.note: scale about the middle of the beam

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: color
params.note: beam colour; default the style accent
